route.method: Direct unmodified native PNG samples. Expected theme ink locates the strongest actual interior glyph-core pixel; max-channel distance<=3 is near-solid and4..48 is explicitly reported strongest antialiased core. Button border/focus interiors and RichTextLabel scrollbars are excluded; ratios use sampled RGB, not constants. Missing interior cores are explicitly reported, not counted as passes. RichTextLabel scrollbar/stylebox regions are excluded from glyph evidence. Adjacent stable3x3 rendered backing samples include texture variation in local22×14pixel annulus; minimum and maximum retained. Non-fullcoverage antialias fringes excluded from numerical ratio but visually reviewed separately. Luminance sRGB<=0.04045: c/12.92; else((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; Y=.2126R+.7152G+.0722B; ratio=(Ylight+.05)/(Ydark+.05).
